instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS with the defined color hex codes directly using arbitrary values or extending the theme.
The app has a Neo-Brutalist twist: heavy 2px black borders (#111111) and hard shadows (e.g. shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#111111]) are MANDATORY on cards, buttons, and inputs.
Do not use generic border-radius (keep rounded-none or very small like rounded-sm) to maintain the brutalist raw feel.
The layout must be mobile-first. For desktop, contain the main feed within a max-w-lg container centered on the screen (resembling a mobile app frame) with a border on left and right.
Highlight 'Offer' posts explicitly by overriding the card background to the 'offer_highlight' color (#FFE973).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='post-like-btn', data-testid='login-submit-btn').
Use Lucide-react for icons with strokeWidth={2.5} for bolder appearance.
Don't build complex real-time features; focus on a snappy, static UI feeling. Use dummy data using the provided avatars and placeholders if a backend isn't ready.
